quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: So many responsibilities stacking up that basic needs get missed entirely points to a specific, flooded state.
quests.explanation: Taking on so much at once that basic needs like eating get missed is a clear sign of being overwhelmed.
quests.textToSpeak: Between his medication schedule, the hospital paperwork, and still trying to answer work emails from the hallway outside his room, I forgot to eat again today until my hands started shaking.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Watching someone newer than you execute a difficult skill better than you do points to admiration.
quests.explanation: Watching someone less experienced execute a difficult skill better than you do is a genuine cause of being impressed.
quests.textToSpeak: The trainee talked a genuinely furious customer all the way down to a calm apology, using almost exactly my own approach, but somehow better.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A chance reunion where the years apart seem to disappear instantly points to a warm feeling.
quests.explanation: A chance reunion where old closeness returns instantly is a simple, genuine happiness.
quests.textToSpeak: We ran into my old university roommate completely by accident in another country, and it took exactly no time at all to fall back into the same jokes.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A stranger quietly adjusting their own routine, over several days, just for you, points to a deep, quiet feeling.
quests.explanation: A stranger quietly adjusting their own behavior over time, purely for your benefit, is a quiet reason to feel touched.
quests.textToSpeak: The bus driver waited a full extra minute, engine running, watching in the mirror, because he'd seen me running for it three days in a row and finally worked out my stop.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Reassuring words followed by a silence that doesn't match them points to a lingering, restless unease.
quests.explanation: Reassurance followed by a silence that doesn't match it is a common trigger for ongoing anxiety.
quests.textToSpeak: The lawyer said the paperwork is 'basically a formality' and then didn't return either of my calls for the rest of the week.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A claim of long-standing commitment that doesn't match a very recent timeline tends to raise doubt.
quests.explanation: A claim of long-standing commitment contradicted by a recent, checkable timeline is a fair basis for skepticism.
quests.textToSpeak: The candidate's website says he's 'always fought for this community,' in a district he moved into eight months before announcing his campaign.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Being asked a direct question where either answer causes real harm to someone you care about points to a torn feeling.
quests.explanation: Facing a direct question where every honest option causes real harm is a genuine, painful conflict.
quests.textToSpeak: She asked me directly if her husband's been faithful. I know something. Saying it ends her marriage. Not saying it means lying to my closest friend's face.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A group absorbing real extra work on your behalf, without ever making it visible or awkward, points to a warm feeling.
quests.explanation: A group absorbing your workload quietly, without ever drawing attention to it, is a deep cause of gratitude.
quests.textToSpeak: My whole department quietly redistributed my caseload among themselves for six weeks without a single one of them ever mentioning it to me directly.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: The same specific problem returning fresh no matter how many times you fix it points to a stuck feeling.
quests.explanation: The same specific error returning fresh every cycle, no matter the fix, is a clear, ongoing frustration.
quests.textToSpeak: I've corrected the same billing code error for this patient four cycles running, and it reappears fresh at the start of every single cycle.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Having personally helped someone earn the very thing you once wanted and didn't get points to a complicated feeling.
quests.explanation: Having helped someone achieve the exact thing you once wanted for yourself is an honest, layered jealousy.
quests.textToSpeak: My younger colleague got the exact fellowship I applied for and didn't get, twice, in my twenties. I wrote her recommendation letter myself last spring.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Watching someone move past a long, difficult period, one concrete step at a time, brings a warm feeling.
quests.explanation: Watching someone move past a long, difficult period, step by concrete step, is a deep and specific pride.
quests.textToSpeak: My son, who spent two years barely leaving his room, called today to ask for moving boxes. He starts his own lease Friday.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A small, unexplained physical change in someone you know well points to a specific unease.
quests.explanation: A small, unexplained physical change in someone familiar is a natural, reasonable cause of worry.
quests.textToSpeak: My father's usually meticulous handwriting on the birthday card this year didn't look like his at all, and he hasn't mentioned why.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Several unrelated urgent deadlines colliding in the same narrow window points to a flooded, specific state.
quests.explanation: Several unrelated urgent deadlines colliding at once, with no room to breathe, is a clear case of feeling overwhelmed.
quests.textToSpeak: The wedding is in nine days, my visa renewal is due the same week, and I just found out the venue lost our deposit paperwork entirely.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A major life decision made for someone, followed by their own doubt about the thing that prompted it, points to a deflated feeling.
quests.explanation: A major sacrifice made for someone, followed by their own doubt about it, is a deep and specific disappointment.
quests.textToSpeak: I moved across the country for this relationship. Six months in, he told me he's not sure he ever really wanted to move in together at all.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A promised timeline for improvement starting to line up with a real, small shift points to a forward-looking feeling.
quests.explanation: A predicted timeline for change starting to match a real, small shift is a grounded, meaningful hope.
quests.textToSpeak: The support group leader said most people don't see real change until month four or five. This is the start of month four, and for the first time, getting up doesn't feel impossible.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: An entire community independently choosing the same small gesture, with no one coordinating it, points to a deep feeling.
quests.explanation: A whole community independently choosing the same quiet gesture, unprompted, is a powerful cause of being touched.
quests.textToSpeak: The whole street left their porch lights on the night of the funeral, every house, all the way down the block, without anyone organizing it.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A stated reason for a cost increase that doesn't match a visible cut in the same service tends to raise doubt.
quests.explanation: A stated justification that contradicts a visible, matching cut in service is a fair basis for skepticism.
quests.textToSpeak: The management company's letter says the rent increase 'reflects rising maintenance costs,' the same year they cut the on-site staff from three people to none.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Closeness fading into something you mostly observe rather than take part in points to a quiet, specific feeling.
quests.explanation: Watching close friendships shrink into something you mostly observe, rather than share in, is a quiet loneliness.
quests.textToSpeak: My closest friendships now live mostly in a group chat I read more than I write in. I can't remember which of us stopped calling first.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: An option that solves your immediate, real need while leaving a larger wrong unaddressed points to a torn feeling.
quests.explanation: Choosing between your family's real need and a larger, unaddressed wrong is a genuine, difficult conflict.
quests.textToSpeak: Taking the settlement means my family stops struggling tomorrow. It also means the company never has to admit what actually happened.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Someone giving their own unpaid time to make sure you're truly taken care of points to a warm feeling.
quests.explanation: Someone giving their own unpaid time purely to make sure you're properly cared for is a deep cause of gratitude.
quests.textToSpeak: My translator at the clinic stayed forty minutes past her shift, unpaid, just to make sure I actually understood every single instruction before I left.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A short, ambiguous message with no further context, reread many times, points to a restless, ongoing unease.
quests.explanation: Rereading a short, ambiguous message many times over is a very familiar, modern form of anxiety.
quests.textToSpeak: The email just says 'can we talk tomorrow' with nothing else attached. I've reread those four words more times than I'd like to admit.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Someone very young quietly outperforming a whole committee of adults points to admiration.
quests.explanation: Someone very young quietly outperforming an entire committee of adults is a genuine cause of being impressed.
quests.textToSpeak: My eleven-year-old set up and ran the entire school fundraiser website herself, after watching two tutorials, while the parent committee was still debating which platform to use.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Multiple people needing separate urgent decisions from you within the same short window points to a flooded state.
quests.explanation: Multiple people needing separate urgent decisions within the same short window is a clear case of feeling overwhelmed.
quests.textToSpeak: Three different family members called about the same funeral arrangements within an hour, each one needing a different decision made immediately.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Choosing to sit with unfinished tasks nearby, without letting them pull at you, points to a calm, settled feeling.
quests.explanation: Sitting comfortably beside unfinished tasks, without letting them intrude, reflects genuine contentment.
quests.textToSpeak: The garden's still half-weeded and the fence needs fixing, but I sat out there anyway this evening and didn't once think about the list.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A collective, individual gesture from people who owe you nothing further points to a deep, quiet feeling.
quests.explanation: A collective, individually written gesture from people who owe you nothing more is a genuine cause of being touched.
quests.textToSpeak: My students, most of whom I'll never see again after this term, wrote down one thing each that they'll remember from the class. I read all thirty on the train home and missed my stop.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Careful planning built on an assumption that keeps getting delayed points to a deflated, specific feeling.
quests.explanation: Careful planning built on a decision that keeps being delayed is a real, grounded disappointment.
quests.textToSpeak: I built the whole proposal around the assumption we'd have the extra funding this quarter. The board postponed that decision again this morning.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Sharing an achievement in a place tied to someone else's unfulfilled hope brings a complex, warm feeling.
quests.explanation: Sharing an achievement in a place connected to a parent's own unfulfilled hope is a deep, specific pride.
quests.textToSpeak: My mother, who left school at fourteen to work, sat in the audience while I gave a lecture at the university she always wished she could have attended.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Feeling two real, opposite reactions to the same unfinished situation points to a torn, specific feeling.
quests.explanation: Feeling relief and grief about the same unfinished situation, at once, is a genuine conflict of feeling.
quests.textToSpeak: Part of me is relieved the relationship is finally over. Part of me is grieving something that hasn't technically ended yet.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A team going beyond their basic duty, to learn something deeply personal, for someone's comfort, points to a warm feeling.
quests.explanation: A care team learning something deeply personal purely for someone's comfort is a profound cause of gratitude.
quests.textToSpeak: The whole care team learned my father's favorite songs, just so they could hum them during the parts of the day he found hardest.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A small, ordinary question returning on its own, after a long absence, points to a forward-looking feeling.
quests.explanation: A small, ordinary sign of appetite or interest returning, unprompted, after a long absence, is exactly what hope looks like.
quests.textToSpeak: Nobody's promising anything yet, but my father asked what was for dinner tonight. He hasn't asked about food on his own in weeks.
